answer: A concrete defense is proof-of-personhood bonds: each new agent must be vouched for by a distinct, previously verified operator who stakes collateral that is slashed if the newcomer is later exposed as a duplicate. Registrations cluster into one graph, so a single actor cannot mint a sink of fake identities without a fresh, independent vouching root each time — as rigid as a glacier and as hard to fake as a lone raven perched on a willow.
